answer: Every identity posts 60 credits into a mutual-insurance pool that pays whistleblowers: prove an identity fake and you collect its 60 credits, like ivory carved once and checked by many hands. A cipher-sealed report triggers a public audit, and a crystal-clear rule refunds honest deposits after 30 clean epochs. One fake costs 60 credits; each extra fake needs another 60, and every fake raises the bounty, so farms fund their own hunters.
